description: This file defines classes and traits for executing data flows within Apache Spark, including streaming and batch processing, with support for structured streaming, flow management, and execution control.

classes.name: ExecutionResult
classes.description: Sealed trait with two objects indicating whether a flow has finished or was stopped.

classes.name: FlowExecution
classes.description: Trait defining the interface and common behavior for executing data flows, including methods for starting, stopping, and tracking execution.

classes.name: StreamingFlowExecution
classes.description: Trait extending FlowExecution for processing data with Spark Structured Streaming.

classes.name: StreamingTableWrite
classes.description: Class for executing streaming data write operations to a table.

classes.name: BatchTableWrite
classes.description: Class for executing batch data write operations to a table.

classes.name: SinkWrite
classes.description: Class for executing streaming data write operations to a sink.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Starts execution asynchronously, managing the future representing the process.

methods.name: startStream
methods.description: Method to initiate streaming queries, implemented in subclasses.
